setup.title: Set up your AI
setup.intro: This feature needs an AI. Desk uses the one you set up yourself, so the work happens on your own computer or with your own key.
setup.own: FlexiLingo's cloud AI is never used unless you switch it on in Settings.
setup.deviceHint: Free and private. Downloads about 2 GB once. Works best with 8 GB of memory or more.
setup.weakMachine: This computer looks modest. The on-device model will work, but answers can be slow. A key of your own is faster.
setup.downloading: Downloading the {{model}} model. This can take a few minutes...
setup.baseUrlHint: For LM Studio, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible server, for example http://localhost:1234
setup.keyOptional: API key (leave empty if the server needs none)
setup.keyPrivacy: The key stays on this computer and is sent only to the provider you chose.

reason.local_not_installed: The local AI engine is not installed on this computer yet.
reason.local_not_running: The local AI engine is installed but not running.
reason.local_no_model: The local AI engine is running but has no model yet.
reason.local_model_missing: The selected model is not downloaded on this computer.
reason.key_missing: No API key is saved for your AI provider.

errors.OLLAMA_NOT_RUNNING: Your AI is not running on this computer.
errors.OLLAMA_MODEL_MISSING: The selected model is not downloaded on this computer.
errors.AI_KEY_MISSING: No API key is saved for your AI provider.
errors.AI_NOT_READY: Your AI is not set up yet.
errors.AI_KEY_REJECTED: The provider rejected this key. Check it and try again.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: The provider says you have used up your limit for now. Try again later.
errors.AI_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach your AI. Check the address and your connection.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong with your AI. Try again.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: Your AI took too long — try a smaller model or your own key.

originHint.device: Generated by the AI on your computer
originHint.ownKey: Generated with your own AI key
originHint.cloud: Generated by FlexiLingo's cloud AI, which you switched on in Settings

settings.title: Your AI
settings.explain: Desk uses your own computer or your own key for every AI feature, so the work runs on your system and costs FlexiLingo nothing. Exam scores and dictionaries still come from FlexiLingo.
settings.cloudDesc: Off by default. When on, word analysis and exam insights are made by FlexiLingo's servers instead of your own AI. Everything else keeps using your AI.
settings.cloudNeedsSignIn: Sign in to a paid plan to switch this on.
settings.cloudInactive: Switched on, but not active: it needs a signed-in paid plan.
settings.cloudActive: Active for word analysis and exam insights.
settings.timeoutHint: If your AI has not answered by then, the request is stopped and you can try again. Slow computers may need longer.
settings.timeoutSaveFailed: The time limit could not be saved. Try again.

wizard.ownKeyLink: Use my own key instead (OpenAI, Anthropic or another server)
wizard.ownKeyReady: Your own AI key is set up. You are ready to go.

engine.notInstalledDesc: Ollama is a free, open-source AI engine that runs on your computer. Install it in one click.
engine.notRunningTitle: Ollama is installed but not running
engine.notRunningDesc: Start Ollama to turn on AI features.
engine.waiting: Waiting for Ollama to become ready...
engine.noModels: No models installed yet. Download one below to get started.
engine.chooseDesc: Smaller models are faster. Larger ones are more capable.
engine.skipped: You can set up AI later in Settings.
engine.heading: AI Assistant
engine.intro: Desk uses AI to help you learn. It runs on your own computer or with your own key.

models.llama3_2: Fast, great multilingual support. Best balance for most people.
models.llama3_1_8b: Stronger reasoning and grammar correction. Excellent for tutoring.
models.gemma3_4b: Google model with strong multilingual ability. Good for vocabulary exercises.
models.mistral: Strong European language support (French, German, Spanish). Fast.
models.phi4_mini: Microsoft compact model. Quick answers, good for conversation practice.
models.qwen3_8b: Best for Chinese, Arabic and other Asian languages. Alibaba model.
models.aya_expanse_8b: Cohere model trained on 23+ languages. Built for multilingual tasks.
models.llama3_1_70b: Most capable. Needs 48 GB or more of memory. Best grammar and writing feedback.

wait.slowHint: The AI on your computer can take a few minutes. It stops by itself after the time limit set in Settings → Your AI.
wait.timeoutHint: Older computers answer slowly. Choose a smaller model, use your own key, or allow more time in Settings → Your AI.
